theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_fvu_frobenius_from_exhaustive_restrictions
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : ℕ → IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)), (∀ x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ, ∃ i : ℕ, x ∈ F i) → ∀ (V : (i : ℕ) → ValuationSubring (F i)) (P : ValuationSubring (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)), (∀ (i : ℕ) (x : F i), (x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ∈ P ↔ x ∈ V i) → ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (τ : AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ), (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ g : F i ≃ₐ[ℚ] F i, (V i).IsFrobeniusAt g ℓ ∧ ∀ x : F i, τ (x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) = ((g x : F i) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) → P.IsFrobeniusAt τ ℓ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
